notes.title: THANK YOU + COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UzCH0zC2Lfk;full][/previewyoutube]

THAT'S CONTENT BABYYY

Subway Midnight has been out for a whole week! We received an overwhelming amount of love for the game, and with that... so many epic fan creations! The weekend was spent watching our Discord fill with people discussing what endings they got, how scared they were, and how to solve whatever weird bug they somehow managed to find. 

HEAPS of you managed to stream or record content of Subway Midnight for your own online communities, so we decided to throw together some of our favorite moments! Watching everybody's reaction to Colin's Basement will always be the highlight. Always.

Share your stuff!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41261290/737a402d219ae8a3524b63fcd10f50536b8afdbb.png

notes.title: Hotfix V1.0.1
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 of Subway Midnight is now live! This fixes the most critical reported bugs preventing the game from being run or progressed.

Bug Fixes & Improvements:

 Added an FPS cap to stop lighting people's GPUs on fire
 Disabled Steam VR starting up for no reason
 Fixed invisible wall in the Shark Room
 Fixed the 4Gems wall being opened with only 3Gems
 Slowed down the smashers in the factory level, and fixed a weird load-in that made it unplayable
 Fixed doors in Rose's house staying locked after a bad ending


Thank you all for playing, and for reporting your bugs on the discord! We'll keep a lookout for any other critical issues over the weekend! Happy Halloween!
